findings.evidence: `QuadraticMap.IsRepresentedBy.not_anisotropic` at Representation.lean:97 (`(h : Q₁.IsRepresentedBy Q₂) (hQ₁ : ¬ Q₁.Anisotropic) : ¬ Q₂.Anisotropic`) is already public and in scope; `restrict` is `@[simps]` at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Basic.lean:253 with `toFun v := Q v`, so the isometry condition is `rfl`. Grep for `restrict.*Anisotropic` over `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm` and `code/TauCeti` finds no such lemma.
findings.fix: Add the general lemma to `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Representation.lean`, next to `IsRepresentedBy.not_anisotropic`: `theorem _root_.QuadraticMap.restrict_isRepresentedBy (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (U : Submodule R M) : (Q.restrict U).IsRepresentedBy Q := ⟨⟨U.subtype, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩, Subtype.coe_injective⟩`, and replace lines 187-192 with `(Q.restrict_isRepresentedBy U).not_anisotropic`.
findings.issue: The forward direction (lines 187-192) needs no hypotheses at all: for any `QuadraticMap R M N` and any `U`, `¬(Q.restrict U).Anisotropic → ¬Q.Anisotropic`. It is inlined here, so the only way a consumer gets it is via `not_anisotropic_restrict_iff_of_finrank_eq_three`, which demands `Q.Nondegenerate`, `finrank V = 4`, `finrank U = 3` and `discr = 0`. General infrastructure locked behind a quaternary-specific interface.

findings.issue: The `## Main results` block lists only `equivalent_hyperbolicPlane_prod_self` and `not_anisotropic_restrict_iff_of_finrank_eq_three`, omitting the third public theorem `not_anisotropic_restrict_of_finrank_eq_three` (line 141), which carries the actual content of the result.

summary: The two substantive theorems are exposed correctly and the private helpers are genuinely proof-local, but the fully general direction "the restriction is isotropic ⟹ the ambient form is isotropic" is inlined inside the iff proof, so that hypothesis-free fact is only reachable through Nondegenerate + finrank = 4 + discr = 0. The module header also advertises only two of the three public theorems.
